review_rules: Do not select one Dwemer-disappearance theory as fact merely because it is popular in community interpretation.
Separate Kagrenac's documented actions from inferred goals and later developer explanations.
Walk-Brass, Brass God, Numidium and Tower terminology should be linked but not mechanically treated as interchangeable in every source.
Tonal architecture claims require passage-level provenance because the term is often expanded by community synthesis.
Landfall material remains future/external developer fiction unless separately evidenced in released material.
